title: A failure whose outcome is no-answer or refused but which came with an answer from the provider is worded 'did not answer' when it has no hint of its own
evidence: Brad decided 2026-11-26 (docs/decisions-for-brad.md). describeStorageFailure (packages/health-core/src/sync-manager.ts unworded) words a StorageError with no hint from one table by outcome and reason: a refusal says it refused, a status says 'returned an error', an answer that could not be used says so; none says 'did not answer'. SyncManager marks its write's failure afterRead, so an access refusal there says only 'Nothing was written' (hosted MCP too, untouched). US-10 AC20; storage-failure-words.test.ts. Shown by the hosted MCP, the stdio server and the CLI; the iPhone engine passes the message to Swift, which shows its own words by kind (SyncProblem.swift).
